# SkillPot

SkillPot is a library of practical, selectively installable agent instructions. It is not an agent runtime, registry, or installer. Published collection v0.5.0 is pinned at commit 044213fd00343e94b4d389c3ca2c0f2909feb79f and contains seventeen bundles, including seven additions: claim-check 0.1.1, verification-loop 0.2.0, and five 0.1.0 workflows. Upstream product projects remain canonical.

## Start
Published v0.5.0 contains seventeen skills: seven pinned public project/contributor packages covering Intpot, Summonpot, Dexpot and Refpot, plus the original repository-readiness, decision-brief and document-actions workflows. The published collection includes all seventeen workflows. Install only claim-check with `npx skills@1.7.6 add https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/tree/044213fd00343e94b4d389c3ca2c0f2909feb79f --skill claim-check` (Node.js 22.20+ and Git required). See the [claim-check first-use guide](https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/blob/main/docs/claim-check-first-use.md). Change-impact maps a specified code change to evidence-backed consequences in impact.md and focused check recommendations in verification.md, without modifying code or running tests by default. Static dependency evidence is not runtime reachability. See its [one-command first-use guide](https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/blob/main/docs/change-impact-first-use.md). Bug-repro produces a minimized runnable reproducer, regression test and repro.md with actual command evidence under explicit execution permission, without silently fixing the target. Not reproduced and Blocked are valid outcomes. See the [bug-repro first-use guide](https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/blob/main/docs/bug-repro-first-use.md). Incident-triage produces incident.md and timeline.md from bounded symptoms/logs, with observed impact, source-linked events, supporting/contradicting hypotheses and next checks. Inspection-only by default; no implicit diagnostics, production changes or claimed fix from a passing retry. See its [incident-triage first-use guide](https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/blob/main/docs/incident-triage-first-use.md). Benchmark-audit reviews existing evidence into benchmark-audit.md with four claim-level verdicts and explicit evidence boundaries; inspection-only, without benchmark or model execution. See the [benchmark-audit first-use guide](https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/blob/main/docs/benchmark-audit-first-use.md). This discovery establishes availability, not task efficacy. Document-actions extracts source-stated assignments and requirements into actions.md and questions.md, keeping proposals and completed/cancelled history separate, deadlines verbatim and conflicts explicit. It does not invent acceptance or operate a task tracker. Decision-brief produces a proposed recommendation and evidence ledger from a bounded input packet; it does not accept or implement the decision. Use the stable v0.5.0 checkout for any selected released workflow; first-use steps pin release commit 044213fd00343e94b4d389c3ca2c0f2909feb79f. Refpot is a preview and repository-readiness remains experimental. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Hermes use their documented native skill mechanisms. Installation copies instructions, not product dependencies or additional authority. Full MIT source notices are retained per package.

- [Experiment-design published first use](https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/blob/main/docs/experiment-design-first-use.md): prospective, permission-aware experiment.md with causal contrasts and frozen schedule/analysis; no execution by default.
- [Verification-loop published first use](https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/blob/main/docs/verification-loop-first-use.md): version 0.2.0 executes within existing local authorization, discovers documented commands and produces acceptance-linked verification.md. It plans without execution permission, offers optional qualified project recipes and incident-backed diff-triggered rule candidates, and requires separate repair/policy approval.
- [Invariant-audit current source-only first use](https://github.com/tugrulguner/skillpot/blob/main/docs/invariant-audit-first-use.md): 0.1.0 inspects one named guarantee against bounded source/observations and produces seven-section invariant-audit.md; inspection-first, not formal proof or execution evidence. Not in stable v0.5.0; separately pinned nine-file installation, exact lock/list/removal and sibling preservation verified; not native activation or task efficacy.
